Full-Stack Developer at NexaCloud Solutions, focused on building scalable SaaS solutions. My work bridges backend systems and frontend experiences, ensuring seamless integration for real-world use cases.  

Currently, I design REST APIs using Node.js and Python, while leveraging PostgreSQL and MongoDB for data management. AWS infrastructure forms the backbone of our deployment, with CI/CD pipelines automating updates and ensuring reliability. Docker streamlines environment consistency, and Terraform simplifies infrastructure-as-code practices.  

Load balancing is critical for handling traffic spikes, and I’ve integrated it into our architecture to maintain performance. React powers interactive dashboards, connecting backend services to deliver intuitive user experiences.  

Collaboration is key—whether refining database queries or debugging deployment pipelines, I aim to solve problems efficiently. My goal is to contribute to scalable, user-centric SaaS products that adapt to evolving business needs.  

Looking ahead, I’m excited to explore ways to optimize workflows and innovate within cloud-native environments. Let’s connect if you’re shaping the future of software—there’s always room for thoughtful solutions.
